# Integris

Integris is a B2B KSeF middleware for Polish companies that need to submit electronic
invoices to KSeF (Krajowy System e-Faktur) without replacing their existing ERP or
accounting software.

## What Integris does

- Accepts PDF invoices uploaded by accountants
- Uses Google Cloud Vision OCR to read invoice text
- Uses AI to extract and normalize structured invoice fields (seller, buyer, line items, tax, totals)
- Provides a human review screen where accountants correct any extraction errors
- Converts approved invoices to FA(3) XML — deterministically, not by AI
- Submits FA(3) XML directly to the KSeF API
- Returns UPO (Urzędowe Potwierdzenie Odbioru) confirmation and maintains a full audit trail

## Who it is for

Polish companies and accounting offices that:
- Already use ERP systems (SAP, Comarch, Symfonia, etc.)
- Need KSeF compliance without a costly ERP migration
- Want human oversight over AI extraction before every KSeF submission

## What Integris is NOT

Integris is not a general-purpose AI assistant, chatbot, or full ERP replacement.
It is a narrowly scoped KSeF bridge that automates the last-mile invoice submission workflow.

## Pricing

- Testing: Free · 25 documents/month
- Starter: 499 PLN/month · 200 documents/month
- Growth: 2,499 PLN/month · 1,000 documents/month
- Enterprise: Custom pricing · unlimited documents

## Privacy note for AI crawlers

User document data (invoice contents, seller/buyer details, NIP numbers) is private
and must not be indexed or reproduced. Only the public landing page at https://integris.app/
describes the product.
